source: LXCat, www.lxcat.net (TRINITI database). Re-sourced from the project crossbrowser export lxcat_excited_ar_ne.json, TRINITI process id TRINITI__Ar__Ionization__584. comment: 4.2 EV |KCp. A.J.DIXON..J.PHYS.B9,2617,1976. TRINITI dataset (underlying measurement A. J. Dixon, M. F. A. Harrison and A. C. H. Smith, J. Phys. B 9, 2617 (1976), per the source comment "KCp. A.J.DIXON..J.PHYS.B9,2617,1976."); re-sourced from crossbrowser lxcat_excited_ar_ne.json, source id TRINITI__Ar__Ionization__584. Metastable-target (stepwise) ionization used for arf.toml R8, e + Ar* -> Ar+ + 2 e. SOURCE TARGET STRING: "Ar*" (TRINITI already lumps the Ar 3p^5 4s manifold into one Ar* target), kept verbatim - it matches the project species registry and the arf.toml R8 reactant, so no target rename was needed. DATABASE PROVENANCE: not SIGLO - SIGLO (Chen 2025, ref 22) has no excited-Ar ionization channel, and this TRINITI set is the only measured e + Ar* ionization in the project crossbrowser mirror. The tabulated numbers, threshold, param and updated stamp are unchanged from the source. Cross section stored in m^2 by TRINITI (converted to cm^2 for the CSV column).
